+"""Tests for end-to-end feature tags."""
+
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+from end2end import conftest
+
+
+def test_js_headers_tag():
+    mark = conftest._get_backend_tag('js_headers')
+    assert mark is not None
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('webengine,qt_512,qt_515,skip', [
+    (True, True, False, True),
+    (True, False, False, False),
+    (True, True, True, False),
+    (False, True, False, False),
+])
+def test_js_headers_skip(monkeypatch, webengine, qt_512, qt_515, skip):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(conftest.qtutils, 'version_check',
+                        lambda version, compiled=False:
+                        qt_512 if version == '5.12' else qt_515)
+
+    @pytest.mark.js_headers
+    def item_function():
+        pass
+
+    class Item:
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.marks = []
+
+        def get_closest_marker(self, name):
+            return item_function.pytestmark[0] if name == 'js_headers' else None
+
+        def add_marker(self, mark):
+            self.marks.append(mark)
+
+    item = Item()
+    conftest.pytest_collection_modifyitems(types.SimpleNamespace(
+        webengine=webengine), [item])
+    assert any(mark.name == 'skipif' for mark in item.marks) == skip
